text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go to Director Akikawa's private
beach for
some extracurricular activities
one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But while we're in the middle of a
long-distance
swim, we suddenly get
caught in a huge storm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, is this for real?! Did we seriously
get swept
onto a deserted island?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
sure... I guess. But we're literally in
the
worst possible situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems shaken up by the

unexpected turn of events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, our phones still have a
signal, and we're able to contact
Director Akikawa, who
organizes a
rescue squad to come get us soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... If I'd known this would happen, it would've just stayed home and trained at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, we wouldn't have
gotten swept
out to the middle
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her how training in
conditions different from what she's used
to can help her
adapt and run in all sorts
of situations.
choice_data_list: Field trips have a real purpose to...
Field trips have a real purpose to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then that means I'm getting left further
and
further behind the others...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Just thinking about that makes me
so mad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's practically gnashing her teeth in
frustration.
I try to think of what I can do
to make her feel
better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Narita Taishin that if we train
while we're
waiting to be rescued, then we can
minimize lost
time.
choice_data_list: There's training we can do even here!
Let's do our best so they can find...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine. I'll do whatever exercises you can
think up,
so let me at 'em.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps feeling the pressure, Narita
Taishin shows a surprisingly willingness
and quickly agrees to my
proposal. I put
together a training list for her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh! There are so many branches and
rocks in
the sand! I can't run properly
with them in my
way!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(What kind of race would be on such a
beaten-up
track?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Do you seriously think I don't know what
to do?!
choice_data_list: Look ahead carefully and find the ...
Look ahead carefully and find the ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running on the obstacle-filled beach
appears to improve her leg strength and
decision-making
skills better than
regular beach running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You want me to catch fish with my
bare
hands? Is this seriously training?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Really?
If it turns out you're lying just to
get some
food, I'm gonna wring your
neck!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Argh, damn it! They keep darting
around!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You wanna mess with me? Then I'll catch all of you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-I got one?! Trainer, what do I do
with
this?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's all slimy and freaking out...
Hurry up
and do
something!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's one fish down! I'm gonna
catch a
huge one next.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What are you smiling about?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What are you talking about,
bonehead?
You think I'm playing here?!
choice_data_list: I was just thinking it's nice to s...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why am I doing all the work anyway?
Don't just
stand there. Pull some weight,
slacker.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Go look for shellfish in the sand or dive
for sea
urchins or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend our time completely absorbed
in
training with the natural equipment
around us
until we're rescued.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training appears to pay off as Narita
Taishin
improves substantially after we
get home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that we write "SOS" in the sand
to make
it easier for the rescue squad to
find us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
okay. I'll get all restless if I don't
do
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We search the area and find a large
branch we
can use to write the rescue
message.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes over writing the message, and
I direct her from far away to make sure
the letters are
large enough to spot
easily.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Roger! ...Oof!
choice_data_list: Next letter, three steps to the right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Damn... It's actually pretty tough writing
these
letters. I guess this counts as
training too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm done! The SOS message is good to
go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How'd you find coconut juice on a deserted... Wait, is that an actual coconut?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I've only seen people drink
straight out of a
coconut in video games.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (This actually tastes pretty good...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew. I'm pooped.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sure.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, um...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The letters in the sand are great and all,
but what
do we do if no one ever finds
us?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. You would say something like that.
choice_data_list: It's something we worked so hard o...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Did I seriously ask a question I knew the answer to and still feel better after getting a response? Ugh, I'm such a doofus.)
Hey... HEEEY!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that... the rescue squad?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wake up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, how can you even sleep at a
time like
this?! Get your act together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
A member of the rescue squad. He's
here because
he saw our SOS message.
choice_data_list: Sorry... And who might this be?

text_block_list.name: Rescue Squad Member
text_block_list.text:
We were able to locate you two sooner
than
expected thanks to that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
choice_data_list: I see... See, what did I tell you?
I see... See, what did I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the unexpected incident was a
huge ordeal, I feel as though I've gotten
a little closer to
Narita Taishin as a result
of today.
